svg.aria-label: Onyx purring: 24 poses, 5 seconds each, repeating every 120 seconds
svg.title: Onyx — Purring
svg.desc: Transparent SVG flipbook with 24 individually separated original poses. Each pose displays for 5 seconds. The full sequence is fully interleaved from the target mood and donor moods, and repeats every 120 seconds. Embedded PNG frames preserve all original image detail and alpha.
